title: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3: Complete Edition
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#993, 2026-11-05), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.25, engine x64-crossover26.3-r28, D3DMetal, rated 3 of 5 after 9 minutes: the Epic copy. The sound runs slow, the animated rollercoaster isn't drawn, the game lags, and loading takes a minute or two. The same with WineD3D. On the Wine 10 engine it slows to a crawl before the legal screen. The environment had ROSETTA_X87_PATH set, which Highball 0.10.25 drops. Not verified by the maintainer. udance4ever again in a comment on highball-db#993 (2026-11-06), on a Wine 11 engine with athei's x87sidecar on (HB_X87SIDECAR=1, which only r30 and r31 carry): the sound is right and the game is snappy. A placed coaster is still drawn as grey mush. udance4ever again in a comment on highball-db#993 (2026-11-06T20:53Z), a log of a run with the grey coaster: the Wine 11 engine r30, D3DMetal mode, the sidecar attached, and nothing in it about drawing. udance4ever again on highball-db#993 (2026-11-07): DXVK mode is very slow, the copyright screen barely fades. The attached log of that run is from the Games environment on the default engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29 without the sidecar, where the game crawls in every mode, so DXVK on r30 with the sidecar is still untested. udance4ever again on highball-db#993 (2026-11-08), the Wine 11 environment on r30 with HB_X87SIDECAR=1 and DXVK mode: at first it looked the same, but zoomed in the coaster is drawn properly and a train runs around it, 60 fps on an M1 by the Metal HUD (screenshot). The earlier slow DXVK run was in the Games environment on Wine 10.
notes: Plays in one report on an M1, the Epic copy, on the Wine 11 engine r30 with athei's x87sidecar on (HB_X87SIDECAR=1, which r30 and r31 carry) and DXVK mode: sound, speed and the coasters are right, 60 fps by the Metal HUD (highball-db#993). In D3DMetal or WineD3D mode a placed coaster is drawn as grey mush. Without the sidecar the sound runs slow and the game lags. On the Wine 10 engine it slows to a crawl before the legal screen. The Steam release also has a native Mac version.

knownIssues.symptom: The sound runs slow and the game lags (M1, Wine 11 r28, D3DMetal and WineD3D)
knownIssues.cause: most likely x87 maths, which Rosetta runs slowly
knownIssues.fix: the Wine 11 engine r30 or r31 with HB_X87SIDECAR=1 in the environment's variables (highball-db#993, 2026-11-06, credit udance4ever)

knownIssues.symptom: A placed rollercoaster is drawn as grey mush (M1, Wine 11, D3DMetal and WineD3D)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The game draws with Direct3D 9, which goes through Wine's WineD3D in D3DMetal and WineD3D mode alike, so it looked the same in both (inferred, highball-db#993)
knownIssues.fix: DXVK mode on the Wine 11 engine r30 with HB_X87SIDECAR=1 draws it properly, 60 fps on an M1 (highball-db#993, 2026-11-08, screenshot, credit udance4ever)

knownIssues.symptom: Slows to a crawl before the legal screen on the Wine 10 engine (M1)
knownIssues.fix: the Wine 11 engine gets past it
